card.name: Skin-test wheal sizes and NCI grading
card.fires_on: The space before a number giving wheal or erythema size in mm in skin-test text, and the words 'the' or 'National' just before a named measuring standard. Seen in histamine skin-test descriptions and in 'graded by National Cancer Institute' lines.
